purpose: Separate gross reported reserves from legally accessible, liquid, unencumbered FX available for dollarization.
gross_identity: GrossReserves = Gold + FXDeposits + ForeignSecurities + SDRHoldings + IMFReservePosition + OtherReserveAssets
net_usable_fx_formula: NetUsableFX = CashFX + LiquidForeignSecurities + ConvertibleSDR + UnencumberedGold*Haircut + CommittedFinancing - BlockedAssets - PledgedAssets - ContestedAssets - ShortTermDebtService - EssentialFXBuffer
eligibility_rule: A reported reserve asset receives 100%, a documented haircut, or 0% immediate-dollarization eligibility only after liquidity, custody, legal access, encumbrance, and sanctions status are documented.
